body:
## Pull request overview

This PR introduces an Airtable-style inline view configuration panel as a right sidebar, eliminating the need to navigate away from the main object view when editing view settings. It adds breadcrumb navigation showing the object-to-view hierarchy and a record count footer for better context.

**Changes:**
- New `ViewConfigPanel` component with six sections (Page, Data, Appearance, User Filters, User Actions, Advanced) for read-only display of view configuration
- Modified `ObjectView` to toggle the inline panel instead of navigating to ViewDesignerPage, added breadcrumb header and record count footer
- Added 25 i18n keys across all 11 supported locales for the new UI elements
- Comprehensive test coverage with 11 new tests for ViewConfigPanel and 7 new tests for ObjectView integration

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 18 out of 18 changed files in this pull request and generated 6 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |

| `apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx` | Integrated ViewConfigPanel with toggle state, added breadcrumb navigation, record count fetching, and footer display |
| `apps/console/src/__tests__/ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx` | 11 comprehensive tests covering panel rendering, sections, view switching, and edge cases |
| `apps/console/src/__tests__/ObjectView.test.tsx` | 7 new tests for breadcrumb, description, panel toggle/close, admin gating, and record count footer |
| `apps/console/src/__tests__/ViewSwitching.test.tsx` | Updated to handle breadcrumb text appearing in multiple locations (breadcrumb + tab) |
| `apps/console/src/__tests__/ConsoleFeatures.test.tsx` | Updated to handle breadcrumb text duplication and mocked data source |
| `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` | Added 25 translation keys consistently across all 11 locales (en, zh, de, fr, es, ja, ko, pt, ru, ar) |
| `ROADMAP.md` | Added Phase 20 entry for inline ViewConfigPanel feature |
| `ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md` | Updated with Phase 20 completion status |
</details>

The VIEW_TYPE_LABELS constant contains hardcoded English strings that are not internationalized. These labels are displayed directly in the UI (line 189), which violates the coding guideline requiring an English-only codebase with proper i18n support. Consider adding these view type labels to the translation files and using the translation function to display them, or using a mapping that leverages existing i18n keys.

The breadcrumb shows "Object > View" (line 336-340) where the object label appears, and then immediately below it the h1 displays the same object label again (line 341). This creates visual redundancy. Consider whether the h1 should display the view label instead, or if this duplication is intentional for hierarchical clarity. The current implementation matches the PR description but may benefit from UX review. ```suggestion

{activeView?.label || t('console.objectView.allRecords')}

```

The `recordCount` prop is defined in the `ViewConfigPanelProps` interface (line 54) but is not destructured in the function signature and is never used in the component. Either use this prop to display record count information in the panel, or remove it from the interface if it's not needed.
